burn_down.rule: During the final window before a reset, and during after-hours, the reserve for that period drops to emergency_reserve_pct, releasing expiring capacity to queued Hunter work. Expiring capacity has no value after reset, so it is not preserved.

capacity_watch.role: Pacing control, not an engine. It sets a mode that the dispatcher honors: pause, slow, normal, or accelerate.

daily_plan.rule: Usable = 100 - reserve - used, per period. Half of usable daily capacity is paced across the day window (now to 18:00 America/Chicago). The rest, and any excess before a daily reset, is scheduled into the after-hours window before the reset. Weekly usable caps the total. Planned slots run in queue rank order and dispatch honors their run_after time.

chatgpt_work.capacity_source: Settings > Usage (5-hour and weekly remaining %, reset times), recorded via `hunter_orchestrator.py capacity-record`
chatgpt_work.enable_when: A capacity snapshot has been recorded and reviewed for at least one full weekly reset.

claude_co_work.capacity_source: Unverified. No supported live-usage read or dispatch mechanism has been confirmed. Snapshots are recorded manually until one is verified.
claude_co_work.enable_when: A supported capacity signal and dispatch path are documented and verified.

claude_code_headless.capacity_source: claude.ai Settings > Usage (session/weekly), recorded via `hunter_orchestrator.py capacity-record`
claude_code_headless.enable_when: A capacity snapshot has been recorded and reviewed for at least one full weekly reset, same as chatgpt_work.
claude_code_headless.note: Verified 2026-10-06: a non-interactive `claude -p` call, run from this repo with Read/Glob/Grep/WebSearch allowed, returns a well-formed packet and draws from the Pro session/weekly limits (confirmed against claude.ai Settings > Usage before and after two test calls). Unlike chatgpt_work and claude_co_work, dispatch can run this one automatically -- there is no browser step.

lease.not_started_ttl_by_engine_note: RB-DEFECT-2026-10-09: the default 240-minute 'not started' TTL assumes a real `start` signal exists to distinguish 'stuck' from 'quietly in progress' -- true for claude_code_headless (hunter_claude_transport.py calls cmd_start the moment it kicks off), false for chatgpt_deep_research/chatgpt_work, which have no API path back to this ledger at all: they just read an assignment file from Drive and research it. Confirmed live: a Deep Research lease expired via this TTL and got silently reassigned to a different target after exactly 4 hours of pure silence -- harmless that day only because Deep Research had also independently reported the capability itself was unavailable (so nothing was really in flight to abandon), not because the TTL was actually safe for these engines. 1200 minutes (20 hours) roughly matches the real refresh cadence of this system's Drive-based assignment export (about once a day) rather than the hourly cadence of the Tasks that merely check whether anything new is there -- long enough that realistic research (no observed run anywhere near this long) is never cut off mid-flight, short enough that a truly abandoned assignment (Task disabled, account issue) still self-heals within about a day instead of lingering indefinitely.
lease.rule: A lease is a hold, not an attempt. An unstarted lease expires back to queued without counting. An attempt begins only at `start` (Deep Research actually kicked off) and counts when it expires or is released.

objective: One prioritized Hunter queue dispatched across ChatGPT Deep Research, ChatGPT Work, and Claude Co-Work/Research. The assignment and validation standard never change with the engine. Capacity decides which engine runs and when; it never lowers research requirements.

adjust_rule.applied_by: CoS, recorded in the adjustment ledger with the evidence used. Values stay within min_pct and max_pct.
adjust_rule.lower_when: The period ended with at least lower_when_unused_pct of the engine's total unused, with no run-out reported in that period.
adjust_rule.raise_when: Todd reports running out of bandwidth in the period, or the period's observed interactive usage reached the reserve floor before reset.

reserve.meaning: Share reserved for Todd's development and day-to-day work. Hunter may use only the remaining share.
reserve.unit: percent of each engine's daily total and each engine's weekly total

routing.ordering: Queue rank is authoritative. Within a rank, engines are tried in preference order and only if they pass their reserve floor.

short_window.rule: A shorter-duration allowance (such as a 5-hour window) is never drained below its reserve, even when weekly capacity remains.
